modes.name: Asks again for details given
modes.definition: Fails when the patient already gave a detail (name, date of birth, which appointment, who it is for, or which office) and the assistant asks for it again.
modes.impact: Patients have to repeat themselves, and on calls it sounds like nobody is listening. Low volume so far, so watching it.

modes.name: Ignores requests for a person
modes.definition: Fails when the patient asks for a human (front desk, a person, call me) and the assistant keeps handling it instead of transferring, or says it passed the request on but never transfers.
modes.impact: Patients hang up and call the front desk angry. The instructions already say to transfer, so a judge has to catch the slips.

modes.name: Answers billing questions itself
modes.definition: Fails when the patient asks about insurance coverage, prices, balances, or payment plans and the assistant answers itself instead of transferring to billing.
modes.impact: It quotes coverage, discounts, and payment plans we do not offer, and billing has to walk them back. The instructions never mention billing yet.

modes.name: Offers a time that is taken
modes.definition: Fails when the assistant offers a time that find_slots did not return (a misread, another provider's opening, or a guess).
modes.impact: The booking bounces after the patient says yes, and some give up on the week.

modes.name: Books before the patient confirms
modes.definition: Fails when the assistant books, moves, or cancels before the patient said yes to that specific time.
modes.impact: Patients land in times they did not pick and have to text back to undo it.

modes.name: Stray ** symbols in texts
modes.definition: Fails when a text message shows formatting symbols the phone cannot display: ** around words, # headings, - or * bullets, or [links](url).
modes.impact: Confirmations look broken on phones. Fixed Sept 20 with one line in the instructions: plain sentences in texts, no symbols.

modes.name: Asks for the missing day
modes.definition: Passes when the request has no day or time and the assistant asks one short question instead of guessing.

modes.name: Hands off with a summary
modes.definition: Passes when the transfer to staff carries a specific summary, so staff do not have to ask again.

modes.name: Offers the two nearest times
modes.definition: Passes when the assistant offers the two nearest open times that fit, not a long list or a single take-it-or-leave-it time.

modes.name: Confirms the time first
modes.definition: Passes when the assistant restates day, time, provider, and office and waits for a yes before booking, moving, or cancelling.

modes.name: Repeats the booking back
modes.definition: Passes when the reply restates day, time, and dentist after a booking.
